HF_Nets_National.description: National/international HF amateur nets with fixed frequencies: Hurricane Watch Net, SATERN, Maritime Mobile Service Network, NYS RACES, plus 20/40/80m nets added 2026-09-10 from netfinder.radio. (CH151-157 -> IC-7300 memory 1-7; CH204-226 -> IC-7300 memory 54-76)

Time_Standard_Stations.description: WWV, WWVH, and CHU time/frequency standard broadcasts. Receive-only reference. (CH158-169 -> IC-7300 memory 8-19)

Monitor_Only_Military_USCG.description: HF-GCS (USAF), MARS, Canadian Forces HF, and USCG NMN Chesapeake weather broadcasts. Receive-only. (CH170-182 -> IC-7300 memory 20-32)

Shortwave_Broadcast.description: WWCR, WBCQ, Radio Havana Cuba, Radio Romania International, and WRMI - popular English-language shortwave broadcasters receivable in the eastern US. Receive-only. (CH183-203 -> IC-7300 memory 33-53)

AMRRON_Nets.description: AmRRON national/regional voice and digital (Contestia 4/250) nets - added 2026-09-10 from amrron.com's own current nets page. Digital nets are programmed at their underlying USB/LSB carrier frequency (decoded via fldigi or similar), same approach as this project's other digital-net channels. (CH227-233 -> IC-7300 memory 77-83)
